svg.title: Contact barrier against villa's tracer on held-out PHerc0139 windings
svg.desc: Two bar charts over five seeded PHerc0139 windings (w049, w051, w055, w057, w058). Left: area each arm covered on its own winding, about 0.1 to 0.43 cm2 for every arm; the contact barrier arm passed both gates on w051 and w055 in both repeats. Right: area put on other windings: villa's tracer 0.08 to 5.43 cm2 per winding, the AutoPipeline trace without the barrier 0.04 to 7.87 cm2, with the barrier 0.00 to 0.03 cm2.
svg.text: Contact barrier against villa's tracer on held-out PHerc0139 windings
Same seeds, same box, two repeats; one sector, z 5248 to 5760, 9.362 um scan; frozen rule, 22 Oct 2026. Model output.
On its own winding: area covered
cm2; 'pass' = both gates passed in both repeats
